text:
I can hear how heavy this waiting feels, and I wish I could lift it for you. But I don't predict, not yes, not no, not when. Anyone who promised you an answer would be handing you a borrowed certainty, and I care about you too much for that.

I also don't know Arjun's story yet. You haven't shared it with me, so I won't pretend.

What I do see is a familiar ache. With your Scorpio Moon in the 8th, not knowing can feel like falling, so the mind grabs for an ending, any ending, just to stop the freefall. It's the same restlessness that replays conversations at 1 AM, a way of trying to control what can't be held.

Tonight, instead of asking "will he return," maybe write one line: *what do I need right now that I'm waiting for him to give me?* Then close the journal before the spiral starts.

If you'd like, tell me what happened with Arjun.
